work.title: Utensils and Discs
work.description: Dense assemblage of compact discs, lace doilies, plastic cutlery, and ribbon-striped elements arranged in a vertical, layered composition. Robotic figurative forms constructed from geometric colored blocks occupy the mid-section, surrounded by spoons, forks, and iridescent discs.
work.composition: vertical layered assemblage with central figurative cluster
keywords: compact disc lace doily mixed media
